message.content: I wake up around nine, usually after a few hours of sleep. I make myself a bowl of porridge for breakfast and then get dressed. I take the bus to the stationery shop, which is about a twenty-minute ride. My job is pretty routine—pricing notebooks, restocking pens, and handling the till. I don’t have many customers early in the morning, so it’s usually quiet. Sometimes I hear that voice, but it doesn’t bother me too much unless I’m tired. I try to keep things as regular as possible.
